newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends down on import dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends down on import dlr demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed a shade down on late import covering demand by a foreign bank, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.09 to the dollar, after opening at 57.07. The rupee closed at 57.03 on Monday.
"The exchange rate moved between 56.96 and 57.09. Speculative selling brought the dollar down, while import covering by a foreign bank drove it back up," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Sellers were speculating that the dollar's rise would be limited due to recent relaxation of monetary policy, he said.
